detailed_description:
Photoreal live-action, Ferrier's farm, Utah, 1860, window from the left, deep shadow, 35 mm film grain.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:08. The shot begins from <Picture 4>: a medium shot of the sitting-room with two young men in possession of it: a long pale fair-haired young man leaning back in the rocking-chair with his boots up on the black stove, and a bull-necked sandy-haired youth standing at the window with his hands in his pockets, the window sun across the table. The camera is at the door end of the room level with a standing man's chest, three long strides from the table, a 35mm lens. The window sun comes from the LEFT across the table. At the first frame the pale young man in the rocking-chair fills the RIGHT third of the frame with his boots on the black stove at the RIGHT edge. The bull-necked youth stands at the LEFT third against the bright window. The sunlit pine table crosses the BOTTOM third between them and the ceiling boards close the TOP edge in shadow. The camera pushes in on the two men across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth as the rocking-chair rocks back a hand's breadth under the pale young man, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 the youth's fingers drum the window sill, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:08 the camera is pushing in through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
